tests.name: Authenticated upload with reserved size and type
Unsent draft attachment hidden even from conversation participant
Attachment message persists and retries without duplication
Participant can download private file through expiring signed URL
Nonparticipant cannot read metadata, sign or download attachment
Published attachment bytes cannot be replaced
Unsupported MIME, wrong extension and oversized file rejected
Deleted message no longer grants participant a new signed URL

limitations: MIME metadata checks are not malware scanning
Previously issued signed URLs remain usable until their short expiry
Test file and soft-deleted message retained
